name: Ithuriel
role: TFAH literary character (Milton's Paradise Lost) -- Gabriel's officer who finds Satan crouched at Eve's ear.
description: TFAH literary character. Category unresolved -- no confirmed source at all. Robert H. West's Milton and the Angels (1955), the standard reference, states the name's origin 'had not been discovered.' See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §V.
narrative_function: Touches Satan (disguised as a toad) with his spear, forcing him back to his true shape.
